headline: Indo Thai Securities allots 235 non-convertible debentures
hook: Micro-allotment of debt securities at Indo Thai
summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited announced the allotment of 235 Secured, Redeemable, Unlisted, Unrated, Non-Convertible Debentures following a board meeting on October 07, 2026. This routine debt issuance involves a very small volume of securities. The company engages in stock broking and financial services. Retail investors see minimal direct impact given the minuscule scale of this corporate action.
why_it_matters: Tiny debt allotment with zero impact on retail holdings

headline: Indo Thai Securities updates exchange on committee meeting outcome
summary: Indo Thai Securities Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding the outcome of its Debenture Issuance, Allotment and Redemption Committee meeting held on October 7, 2026. Procedural details of the committee meeting were submitted for regulatory compliance. Indian retail investors holding shares in Indo Thai Securities should note this routine corporate update.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no immediate impact on stock price.
